Agencies, country representatives and un: Hukumomi, wakilan ƙasa da jami'o'i suna aiki tare da Campus Turkey a ƙarƙashin yarjejeniya ɗaya da shafin yanar gizo ɗaya.
Author: Marubuci
Campus Turkey places international stude: Campus Turkey yana sa ɗaliban ƙasashen waje su sami wuri a jami'o'in Turkiyya, yana kuma kula da biza, masauki da isowarsu. Tun daga 2014, mun yi aiki tare da jami'o'in Turkiyya, asibitoci da hukumomin kasuwanci.
Education is what we are built around. T: Ilimi shi ne ginshiƙin da muka gina a kansa. Sauran ayyukan suna nan ne saboda iyalai sun nema su.
Every university we place students into,: Kowane jami'ar da muke saka ɗalibai a ciki, tare da kuɗin makaranta, harsunan koyarwa da yawan shirye-shirye da ake bayarwa. Tacewa da kallon taswira tare da cikakken shafi.
From first enquiry to your first week in: Daga tambaya ta farko har makonku na farko a Türkiye, da abin da muke bukata daga gare ku a kowane mataki.
Guides, checklists and explainers on app: Jagorori, jerin abubuwan duba da bayanai masu bayani kan yadda ake neman shiga jami'ar Turkiyya, biza, da abin da kwanaki na farko na watan farko ke kashewa.
Housing, everyday costs, working while y: Masauki, kuɗaɗen yau da kullum, aiki yayin karatu, da yadda watan farko a Türkiye yake a zahiri.
Fom ɗaya gajere ne ke fara aikace-aikacenku. Ba ku biya komai kafin a karɓe ku, kuma muna tabbatar da duk kuɗaɗen a rubuce tun farko.
Public universities are heavily subsidis: An ba jami'o'in gwamnati tallafi mai yawa, yayin da jami'o'in masu zaman kansu ke ba da tallafin karatu. Muna tabbatar muku da ainihin abin da za ku biya kafin ku yi nema.
Reach qualified applicants from Africa,: Isar da saƙo ga masu nema da suka cancanta daga Afirka, Asiya ta Tsakiya da Gabas ta Tsakiya ta hanyar wata tashar guda mai ɗaukar alhaki.
Register your agency, refer students, an: Yi rijistar hukumar ku, tura ɗalibai, kuma ku bi diddigin kowace aikace-aikace da kowace kwamitin a cikin ɗaya shafin yanar gizo.
Represent Campus Turkey in your country,: Wakilci Campus Turkey a ƙasarku, tare da yankin da aka ƙayyade da jadawalin kwamitin da aka wallafa.
Study in Türkiye, without the guesswork: Koyi a Türkiye, ba tare da hasashe ba
Tell us what you need and we reply withi: Fada mana abin da kake buƙata, za mu amsa cikin yini ɗaya na aiki. Babu cibiyar kiran waya kuma babu amsa ta atomatik.
What each scholarship covers, who it is: Abin da kowace tallafin karatu ke rufe, wa ya kamata ya nema, da yadda gasar take a zahiri. Ba ma nuna tabbaci ba.
What partners get: Abin da abokan tarayya ke samu
What to expect: Abin da za a sa ran
What you can rely on: Abin da za ka iya dogaro da shi
Where to go next: Ina za a je na gaba?
